## About
Bill Anderson Air is a family owned and operated heating and air conditioning company in Katy. We handle sales, service and installation on all major brands, and we try to give you the kind of old-fashioned, personalized service you'd expect from a neighbor.
We know what humidity in the Katy area does to an AC system, from clogged drain lines to that musty smell from the vents. Our customers have given us a 4.9 rating from 199 Google reviews, and reviewers have told us they appreciate that we don't push repairs or equipment they don't need.

## Services
- HVAC service and repair: We service, repair and install all major HVAC systems and brands.
- Free quotes on new equipment: Thinking about replacing your system? We'll give you a free quote on new equipment.
- Drain lines cleared: If you see water dripping outside, restricted drain lines can back up into your ceiling. Call us and we'll have the drain lines cleared.
- UV light in the plenum: Our recommended fix for musty odors coming from your registers is to install a UV light in the plenum.

## FAQ
Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We cover Katy, Fulshear and Richmond. Staying in our area typically lets us respond faster.

Q: Water is dripping outside my house. Is that a problem?
A: It's not a good sign. Restricted drain lines can plug up and send water through your ceiling, so give us a call right away to have them cleared.

Q: Why do my vents smell like dirty socks?
A: It's called Dirty Sock Syndrome, and it happens a lot around Katy where the air is humid and temperatures swing quickly. We recommend a UV light in the plenum.

Q: The blower runs but no air comes out. What should I check?
A: Check your filter. A dirty filter can make the unit ice up. Remove the filter and shut the unit off for at least 4 hours so it can defrost. If that doesn't do it, call us to open a service call.
